FISHING LICENCE · IRELAND

Ireland fishing licence

A state licence is required for salmon and sea trout. Most waters also require permission or a fishery permit; the state licence does not provide access.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anyone who fishes for salmon or sea trout needs a state licence.

Who doesn’t

  • No state licence is required for ordinary trout, coarse fish or other sea fish. Local permits can still apply.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Salmon and sea trout, one dayany1 dayEUR 36
Salmon and sea trout, all districtsany21 daysEUR 50
Salmon and sea trout, all districtsanyCalendar yearEUR 100

Extra stamps and permits

  • Fishery permit
    For waters where the holder of the fishing rights requires a permit.
  • Midland Fisheries permit
    For trout, pike and coarse fish in the controlled Midland Fisheries waters.

Saltwater

Ordinary sea angling needs no state licence. Salmon and sea trout still require a state licence.

Rules visitors should know

  • Check whether the salmon river is open for harvest, catch and release, or closed.
  • Tag retained salmon and sea trout over 40 cm as required by the tagging scheme.
  • Complete the salmon catch logbook.

How to buy

Buy salmon licences from the IFI online shop or authorised tackle shops. Obtain the water permit from the fishery.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Ireland?

A state licence is required for salmon and sea trout. Most waters also require permission or a fishery permit; the state licence does not provide access.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Ireland?

Salmon and sea trout, one day: EUR 36; Salmon and sea trout, all districts: EUR 50; Salmon and sea trout, all districts: EUR 100 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Ireland?

Buy salmon licences from the IFI online shop or authorised tackle shops. Obtain the water permit from the fishery.
